ValidationRule.description: CR-15: Mindbody hardware (Product Family = Hardware) is sold only in the US, Canada, the UK and Australia. Country = the quote's Ship-To country, else the customer account's shipping, else billing country. Ship-To per line group replaces the quote country in phase 5.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( BEGINS(Product2.ProductCode, 'MB-'), ISPICKVAL(Product2.Family, 'Hardware'), NOT(ISBLANK( BLANKVALUE(Quote.ShippingCountry, BLANKVALUE(Quote.Opportunity.Account.ShippingCountry, Quote.Opportunity.Account.BillingCountry)) )), NOT(CASE(UPPER(TRIM( BLANKVALUE(Quote.ShippingCountry, BLANKVALUE(Quote.Opportunity.Account.ShippingCountry, Quote.Opportunity.Account.BillingCountry)) )), 'UNITED STATES', 1, 'UNITED STATES OF AMERICA', 1, 'USA', 1, 'US', 1, 'CANADA', 1, 'CA', 1, 'UNITED KINGDOM', 1, 'UK', 1, 'GB', 1, 'GREAT BRITAIN', 1, 'ENGLAND', 1, 'SCOTLAND', 1, 'WALES', 1, 'NORTHERN IRELAND', 1, 'AUSTRALIA', 1, 'AU', 1, 0) = 1) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Mindbody hardware is only sold in the US, Canada, the UK and Australia. Remove the hardware line or check the quote's Ship-To country.
